d.t: WALL PANEL FOR WALL MOUNTED LANDSCAPE GREENING
d.s: SikaRoof VersiWall GP Panel is a panel that is mounted onto walls to hold planting pots to create a green wall. Panels are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), while fire-rated panels are manufactured from modified reinforced thermoplastics, and it has multiple points for pots to hook onto to create green walls of different spacings. SikaRoof VersiWall GP Panel is used in conjunction with SikaRoof VersiWall GP 2060 and SikaRoof VersiWall GP 2020 to create a green wall system.
a: Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
Operates within a wide service temperature range
us: Panels are used to create green walls on either internal or external wall facades.
